notes.title: Update 130.000 Players! Thank you!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478791/97a04085ddd6013b7ddf12e90c115fe8e21109b8.png[/img]
Hello players!

[h2]We recently reached 130.000 players on SEXTS![/h2]
I'm really amazed how many people are so committed to improve their typing skill! You rock!

To celebrate the event we are doing a little upgrade of the intro and main menu!
We also improved the loading time between levels.
Here is a complete list:
[b]- New intro screen
- New main menu with girls instead of books[/b]
- ALL Books are gone, the guy who get this idea as been fired.
- Gallery is now available after finishing 3 levels.
- We added a little "parameter menu" on main menu.
- Change some UI here and there in the level selection/gallery to make it smoother.
- Reduced loading time.

Not related but we are also releasing a new game called My Escort Company on May 31st
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1759920/My_Escort_Company/

Also our next Free to Play game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333090/Meet_My_Elf_Girlfriend/

notes.title: Update v1.01+1.02 - Typos fix + Chinese problem fix + Achievements
notes.notes:
Hello naughty players,

v1.01 - 31th January
A quick update to answer the feedback received after release. Two/three typos in English fixed and the chinese language which was bugging a little when pressing enter to validate words (with Windows translation tool). I hope the modifications I made will fix this issue.
Tell me about it.

v1.02 - 1st February
Another quick update to fix more typos ("ebony "). Thank you to all the players who reported bugs in the Steam community or send me PM!
Added a safeguard on Witch Hunter / Primal Expert achievements. (If it doesn't trigger for you, complete a level to trigger it).
Improved the 3D effect on waifus when completed.
Added a restart button on the top left corner for people trying to bit the "very hard" achievement.
